lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like distribution posterior to the fifth branchial slit, with spacing between centroids approximately equal to the diameter of individual blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a defined node-based pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light (top edge) to dark (bottom edge), extending from the post-branchial region toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, dark elongated silhouette (remora) is positioned horizontally along the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and lower flank.
